lines.text: What if ten years from now, you wake up and completely hate your life?
The wolf slides a golden pen across the mahogany table: 'Sign here, kid. An easy road. No struggle.'
The young pup hesitates, clutching his ears in doubt: 'Is there really no catch?'
'None at all,' the wolf whispers with a sly wink. 'Just sign your twenties away.'
With a trembling paw, the pup signs the parchment... and the room fades to black.
Ten years pass in an instant. A cold, lifeless office under buzzing fluorescent lights.
Three in the morning. Lying awake in bed, bathed in the dead blue glare of a phone.
In the dusty bathroom mirror, he clutches an old photo of who he used to be.
And suddenly, you are back in that warm room. The contract lies unsigned.
Ten years were just handed back to you. So what will you choose today?
